# Settings

Every built-in setting with its type, default value and the scopes it can be set at. See [Settings](../settings.md) for where the files live and how scopes combine. Values are written in TOML, for example `editor.fontSize = 16`.

## General

| Setting | Description | Type | Default | Scopes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `app.hotExit` | Keep unsaved changes on exit | boolean | `true` | user |
| `language` | Language | string | `""` | user |
| `navigation.minLineDistance` | Cursor jumps longer than this many lines are recorded for Back/Forward | integer 0–1000 | `10` | user, workspace |
| `search.exclude` | Globs excluded from workspace search | list of strings | `["**/node_modules", "**/target"]` | user, workspace |
| `search.maxFileSize` | Files larger than this are skipped by workspace search (bytes) | integer 1024–1073741824 | `5242880` | user, workspace |
| `search.maxResults` | Maximum number of workspace search results | integer 100–1000000 | `20000` | user, workspace |
| `search.quickOpenMaxFiles` | Maximum number of files Quick Open lists | integer 1000–1000000 | `200000` | user, workspace |
| `search.useIndex` | Keep a search index of the workspace in the cache folder | boolean | `true` | user, workspace |
| `update.mode` | Updates: off, notify when one is available, or download it automatically | `"off"` \| `"notify"` \| `"download"` | `"notify"` | user |
| `workbench.startup` | On startup | `"emptyState"` \| `"restoreSession"` \| `"welcome"` | `"restoreSession"` | user |

## Git

| Setting | Description | Type | Default | Scopes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `git.autoCommit` | Commit automatically | boolean | `false` | user, workspace |
| `git.autoDetect` | Detect Git repositories when a workspace opens | boolean | `true` | user, workspace |
| `git.autoFetch` | Fetch automatically | boolean | `false` | user, workspace |
| `git.autoFetchPeriod` | Seconds between automatic fetches | integer 30–86400 | `300` | user, workspace |
| `git.autoPush` | Push automatically after commits | boolean | `false` | user, workspace (trusted workspaces only) |
| `git.confirmSync` | Confirm before Sync | boolean | `true` | user, workspace |
| `git.decorateTabs` | Tint tab names by Git status | boolean | `true` | user, workspace |
| `git.enabled` | Enable Git integration | boolean | `true` | user, workspace |
| `git.gutterBase` | Gutter change bars compare with | `"index"` \| `"head"` | `"index"` | user, workspace |
| `git.path` | Path of the git executable (empty: from PATH) | string | `""` | user |
| `git.pullMode` | How Pull integrates remote changes | `"ffOnly"` \| `"rebase"` \| `"merge"` | `"ffOnly"` | user, workspace |
| `git.pullOnOpen` | Pull when a workspace opens | boolean | `false` | user, workspace |
| `git.scanNestedRepos` | Detect repositories in the workspace's subfolders | boolean | `false` | user, workspace |
| `git.smartCommit` | When nothing is staged, Commit | `"ask"` \| `"always"` \| `"never"` | `"ask"` | user, workspace |
| `notes.sync.commitMessage` | Sync Notes commit message template | string | `"Notes sync {{date}} {{time}} from {{hostname}}"` | user, workspace |
| `notes.sync.enabled` | Enable Sync Notes (commits and pushes every change) | boolean | `false` | user, workspace (trusted workspaces only) |
